results.title: RemoteEvent
results.summary:
An object which facilitates asynchronous, one-way communication across the
client-server boundary. Scripts firing a `Class.RemoteEvent` do not yield.

results.title: RemoteFunction
results.summary:
An object which facilitates synchronous, two-way communication across the
client-server boundary. Scripts invoking a `Class.RemoteFunction` yield until
they receive a response from the recipient.

results.title: Bindable events and callbacks
results.summary: Bindable events and callbacks allow for back-and-forth communication on the same side of the client-server boundary.

results.title: Remote events and callbacks
results.summary: Remote network events and callbacks allow for back-and-forth communication across the client-server boundary.

results.title: RemoteEvent
results.summary:
Guards access to remote event and function APIs such as
`Class.RemoteEvent` and `Class.RemoteFunction`.

results.title: UnreliableRemoteEvent
results.summary:
An object which facilitates asynchronous, unordered and unreliable, one-way
communication across the client-server boundary. Scripts firing a
`Class.UnreliableRemoteEvent` do not yield.
